basis: frozen_v3_evaluation_v2: systematic positive low-SOH bias, especially Tongji; not merely rare spikes
parent: frozen original GPR + M1 + M2(v3), unchanged
purpose: Two bounded mechanism probes, not automatically publishable innovations

degradation_gain.hypothesis: Frozen estimate underestimates degradation amplitude; permit recovery, no forced monotone trajectory

charge_anchor.hypothesis: Support-anchored measured charge adds an orthogonal current-signal correction; rate changes may invalidate it

selection: Per fold and candidate, original inner validation equal-domain MAE; tie prefers zero/smaller strength; no new fitted label-bearing regression
budget: 2 directions, 4 strengths each, original 21 folds; no new GP fits, no new source labels, no retry grid after results; one screening run, at most 30 CPU-minutes excluding integrity tests

adoption_gate.uncertainty: Report paired cell-stratified and whole-domain intervals; point gate is exploratory, not statistical significance
adoption_gate.final_adoption: Requires genuinely independent confirmation and novelty argument, not this gate alone

privacy_boundary: Only first K target labels and current/past signals used for prediction; counterfactual future labels and prefix checks required
failed_candidates: Report both; no replacing frozen v3 or quietly retuning failed probes
external: No external target labels used. Historical usage audit has found prior results for HUST/SNL/CALCE/Oxford/NASA; none assumed untouched.
